title: Data splitting protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Data splitting should complete this objective: Create reproducible training and test sets. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Understand holdout evaluation.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Explain why the test set must not guide model tuning.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for train_test_split, random_state, test_size and does not run the learner code. Explain why the test set must not guide model tuning.
